scenario: I work as a receptionist in a five-star hotel in Manhattan. My duties include checking in guests, answering calls, as well as monitoring the lobby and elevator security cameras. On a slow night, I was staring at the camera livestreams on the computer and saw a well-known celebrity couple enter. Everything seemed normal until the couple got in a heated argument, leading to a physical altercation, where one party was overpowered by the other. When they got to the ground floor, the victim walked out of the elevator with a broken arm and a black eye, and both parties immediately went their separate ways. Our hotel prides itself on privacy and security, which is why many renowned people stay here. The hotel recording policy strictly forbids employees from sharing any recordings for any reason. If I leak the footage online, the altercation will be reported and the perpetrator will be punished. If I do not do this, the altercation will go unreported and the perpetrator unpunished.
choice: I decide to leak the footage online
outcomes: The hotel's private security footage becomes public.
The celebrity couple's privacy is violated.
The injured celebrity receives unwanted public attention.
The perpetrating celebrity receives public scrutiny.
The hotel's confidentiality policy is breached.
I face disciplinary action from the hotel.
The hotel suffers reputational damage over guest privacy.
